svg.title: ChannelOS with Aniri
svg.desc: ChannelOS is an AI-native channel operating system built for DRUID’s partner organization, with Aniri, a standalone OpenClaw bot delivered through Telegram, at the center of news, discovery, partners, opportunities, targets, and PAM activity.

g.text: One system to run the channel.
One AI Chief of Staff to tell you
